summary: Gameyfin is a self-hosted video game library manager designed to help you organise your digital game collection. It features automated file scanning, a web-based interface, download management, and a plugin system for extensibility.
goodFor: This is a suitable tool if you want to catalogue and browse your self-hosted game library through a centralised web dashboard.
watchOut: The project currently shows signs of limited maintenance activity, meaning you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely updates for new upstream dependencies.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volume mounts for your library files and database, along with a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
